name: test-generation-demo-v1
description: Three self-contained target functions and one behaviour-changing mutation each. Generation validity is always measured; execution, pass rate and regression detection are measured only when the subprocess sandbox is explicitly enabled.
provenance: Authored for this repository. The target functions and mutations are synthetic and small enough to inspect by hand.
limitations: The bundled default provider is the deterministic mock, whose generated suite is a smoke/importability suite with no behavioural assertion. A default run therefore measures generation validity, not useful regression-test quality; execution metrics remain UNKNOWN unless a sandbox is explicitly enabled, and even then they describe the mock. The dataset is tiny and author-labelled.
